steps.observation: You have 60 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Electrify urban transport  
   • Expand reliable, high-frequency public transit powered by renewable electricity.  
   • Build safe bike lanes, e-scooter networks, and pedestrian zones to shift short trips away from cars.  
   • Incentivize electric vehicles and install widespread fast-charging infrastructure.

2. Retrofit buildings for energy efficiency  
   • Mandate high-performance insulation, LED lighting, and smart energy-management systems in new and existing structures.  
   • Offer subsidies or green loans for heat-pump installations and rooftop solar.  
   • Enforce stringent building-energy codes and disclose energy performance to spur competition.

3. Decarbonize the urban power supply  
   • Procure city-wide electricity from wind, solar, and geothermal sources through power-purchase agreements.  
   • Deploy microgrids and community solar to localize clean generation and increase resilience.  
   • Introduce dynamic pricing and demand-response programs so residents and businesses use power when renewable supply is high.
